profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Boston Scientific
profile.summary:
I am a driven Software Engineer with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of Minnesota, where I completed my degree in just three years. After summer each year in university, I have gained hands-on experience through internships at Medtronic and Boston Scientific. I currently work at Boston Scientific and contribute to innovative medical device solutions as an iOS Mobile App Tester. 

In this role, I focus on ensuring the quality, reliability, and user experience of mobile applications that support critical healthcare technologies. My passion lies in advancing technology within the medical device industry to make a meaningful impact on healthcare. 

Outside of work, I remain actively engaged in the lacrosse community as both a player and coach, committed to fostering the growth of this dynamic sport among younger generations.

I am eager to continue applying my technical expertise and passion for healthcare technology to drive innovation and positive change.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Contributed to the Cardiac Rhythm Management department as a Software Engineer.
- Developed Python scripts leveraging Jira APIs to automate test result exports.
- Transformed JSON files into JUnit Report XML format for streamlined reporting.
- Designed and implemented a GitLab pipeline to integrate Jira database data into Report Portal on a scheduled basis.
- Delivered a final presentation showcasing findings and achievements to over 20 Boston Scientific staff members.

positions.title: Medtronic Intern
positions.description:
- Worked in the Metrology and Calibration Department.
- Developed efficient SQL queries to transfer information from a database into PowerBI.
- Presented final findings to over 80 Medtronic Staff Members.
